title: Paramodular consistency tests for Calabi-Yau counting series
exact_target: Determine how paramodular groups organize counting invariants of Calabi–Yau threefolds.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 20002509 (AIM-PHYSICS-0017). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.
American Institute of Mathematics, Gromov-Witten invariants and number theory, source item 3.4.

status_qualification: This is an exploratory programme. A proof for one counting series or one level is a case of the programme, and no universal modularity assertion is added. The catalogue title/status was paired with a machine-generated research attempt; that attempt is not peer-reviewed evidence of settlement. The statement covers the original source questions rather than only the title’s subcase.
